description: A Minecraft mod that adds scooters!

mods.name: Scooters
mods.description: This mod adds two-wheeled stand-up scooters to the game, push scooters and electric ones. Designed to compliment the vanilla game, this mod has no settings that can be set.

releases.notes:
This is the fifth beta release of a major refactor to Scooters mod. Please report any bugs and crashes as you find them.

Changes since 2.0.0-beta.4:

- Added naming scooters in an anvil, the name will show up in the screen when they are in entity form
- Charging stations will now prioritize the scooter immediately in front of them
- Fixed a multiplayer crash when a different player rode a scooter
- Fixed charging stations not dropping as items
- Fixed various issues caused by [Carry On](https://github.com/Tschipp/CarryOn) by adding the entities and the charging block by blocklisting them
- Rework injection of fix for wrong movement

Missing features and bugfixes for full 2.0.0 release:

- Physics refactor (#15)
- Dyeable scooter handles (#10)
- Better inventory syncing (#3)
- Scooter recipes do not work with crafting inventories bigger than 3x3 (#2)
- Angle and position desyncs
- Charger position on a charging electric scooter isn't saved properly (#18)
- Incomplete documentation

releases.notes:
This is the final release of Scooters mod, for the time being. This is not the last beta for 2.0.0, but the last release of Scooters mod as a whole. Ordinarily I wouldn't contemplate marking a pre-release version as final but these are extraordinary times.

Changes since 2.0.0-beta.1:

- Add scooter recipes to EMI
- Made scooters dyeable, they should work with modded dyes
- Made it so scooter items have defaults in the creative inventory
- Added a gross hack to prevent scooters from gaining infinite speed
- Fix short circuiting an electric scooter when it falls in water

Missing features and bugfixes for full 2.0.0 release:

- Physics refactor (#4)
- Dyeable scooter handles (#10)
- Scooter items do not render colored in the inventory
- Better inventory syncing (#3)
- Unlocking recipes in the recipe book before crafting (#11)
- Scooter recipes do not work with crafting inventories bigger than 3x3 (#2)
- Scooters retaining their name if named on an anvil before being placed
- Charger cables are rendered white and too thin when attached to a scooter
- Angle and position desyncs
- Charger position on a charging electric scooter isn't saved properly
- Incomplete documentation
